name: Bad Medicine
objectiveText: Bring 7 Jungle Remedies and 1 Venom Fern Extract to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp. Jungle Remedy  ( 7 ) Venom Fern Extract  ( 1 )

comments.body:
Hey guys just a word of warning! Please dont try to get the jungle remedies from the Medicine Men. The drop rate is very very poor and they are hard to kill. Instead get a mate and go into the cave. There you can kill loads of headshrinkers (perfect for combinong with the mission where u gotta kill a few of them) where the drop rate of jungle remedy from them is almost 100%.
Hope this is useful!

Can confirm that. Went inside. Came out with one...

This comment was so bad, I created a wowhead account just to reply to it. You can NOT combine it with Special Forces quest (the one that wants you to kill headshrinkers) because you can only get that quest after you complete this one.

The boxes with the Fern Extract can be found at 44,9 in front of the two-story house, 44,10 in the middle of the campfire area, or 45,9 next to the stables.

The Medicine Men are a bit of a pain, because they'll heal themselves twice if you don't down them quick enough. If you've got spell interruption abilities, use them when they try to heal; it'll make downing them a lot faster.

Also, the drop rate on the Jungle Remedy is fairly low, you'll be killing quite a few of these guys.
It's in one of the boxes near a campfire. Right click and it shoud come up for you. :)
replies: There is another Box that does not attract as much aggro, it is outside a house. I think it's the most Southern building.

comments.body: Just a FYI after the recent classic release, there was a bug where i could not loot the supplies. Had to abbandon and pick up the quest again, then i was able to loot.

This was pretty easily soloed as a lvl 33 Dwarf Warrior.  Just be sure not to agro too many Kurzen Medicine Men since they are healers and will heal eachother.

The Jungle Remedy drops from Kurzen Medicine Man around the Kurzen Compound located at 43,10.  The Venom Fern Extract can be found near the front door of the building located at 44,9.  Click on the boxes near the front door.

comments.body: I found a house on the west side of the camp, its full of medicine men, that respawn fast.. so it didn't take long to collect the vials. Plus right outside on a crate is the Venom Extract. So this was quick.

i'm attempting to solo bad medicine and the second rebellion with a 31 rogue, and the medicine men are indeed a pain in the ass...however, i've found that a cheap, fledgling version of a stun lock keeps them from healing even once. as long as you can fight only one at a time, it has about a 60-75% success rate so far:

stealth, cheap shot, gouge, backstab, vanish, ambush, then a 5-point kidney shot, and i can usually coast with a sinstrike or two and evisc or slice and dice from there...

the combo points invested into stun time as opposed to straight damage aren't really useful anywhere else, but they help against healers.

i realize this only helps rogues and no one else, but hey, i do what i can :P

This is the most set of quests I've ever had to do so far in this game.  These Medicine Men are teh suck and if you aggro more that two of 'em, it's game over for you.  It also seemed like the area spawned the mob opposite of what you needed.  I was overrun with Fighters when I needed the anti-venom and there were too many Medicine Men when I was hunting fighters.  Add to that the slow drop rate and you have one crappy quest.

Eh, worth the XP, though.

Also, if you are soloing this thing, go for the supplies near the house.  You aggro one of those MM in the middle, you aggro them all.  Not fun.

I started this quest last night, first time in Stranglethorn Vale (level 32 Priest).
The Medicine Men can be a PITA, but easy for a priest with mana.  Priests should attack using their "Mana Burn" attack.  Three hits with that and the medicine men are out of mana and down to about 60% health or so, and they go down easy after that.  At one point I was out of mana and then I found out how nasty these guys are. I fought one and he just kept healing himself over and over (their mana regens fairly quickly). I had to run away from him and drink.

This quest was kind of a pain, but it wasn't too bad. If you come up the path from the west side of the compound, you can find a few of medicine men you can pull: one inside the giant house, one in front of the house near the campfire (near the boxes where you find the jungle fern extract), and one behind that house. There weren't too many medicine men alone, so I would kill them and wait for them to spawn by killing the jungle fighters (Second Rebellion quest).

Easy quest with lvl 40 Lock but miserable drop rate 30mins to get the remedy...
4-5 Medicine Men around camp

The crate is in the center of camp which is 44,10 of Stranglethorn Vale.
The medicine men are best first target (they heal them selves and others).

You can find the compound southeast of the Rebel Camp. Head east following the path, south through the gap and then east again.


The Venom Fern Extract is easy enough to find. Look for a pile of wooden boxes (similar to the ones found behind Corporal Bluth - camp trader - in Rebel Camp). Mouseover them and see if the cog cursor pops up. If it does, you will find the Venom Fern Extract in there.
The only place I have seen these boxes spawn is beside the door of two-story house in the west of camp (not the tower or the lumber mill).

The other half of the quest is harder though. The Medicine Men are quite annoying. They are Priest mobs.

[b]SPELLS:[/b]
INNER FIRE: They keep this buff spell up perpetually. This increases their armour by around 720, I believe. 20 successful hits on the mob will use up this spell's charges and remove it.
RENEW: They cast either Renew on themselves once down to 90% health.
HEAL (Greater? Flash? Not sure): They heal themselves once they reach below 50% health.

Priests have the advantage over these guys.
If you pay attention to their actions you will see when they cast Renew/Rejuvination on themselves. You can then use Dispel Magic to remove it. If you only have Rank 1 you may have to cast twice as the first time may just remove Inner Fire instead.

Once they get down to 50% health they will try and heal themselves. You can either mana burn them until they have no mana beforehand, or simply stop them from healing. To stop them from healing, first ensure you have WoW's new Target-of-Target feature turned on in the bottom of Interface Options. They will target themselves before they try to heal themselves, so the moment they do this, stop them by stunning or silencing them.

I suggest you grind these for their Jungle Remedies a lot. These will serve you well even at level 60.

These guys SUCK. As healers I think they're overpowered -- not only can they cast Inner Fire and Renew, but they also can heal themselves from a sliver to full at least twice over if you're unlucky. Along with that, they're hard to find alone and not in the middle of a bunch of other mobs, and the drop rate on the Remedy just sucks. You can kill five of these guys and get five Remedies... then all of a sudden kill ten and get none.
